Event Story

The documented chapter.

Wild Ones Takes Flight took place in Mission Viejo, California on November 11, 2022. In the current archive, it is the clearest early milestone where the Wild Ones and Bass Babes names are documented together as part of the same event identity.

The page is intentionally ready for the original flyer, confirmed DJ or artist names, event photography and physical artifacts as they are recovered. Those materials can build a more complete record without adding unsupported details in the meantime.
